claim.claim-text: 2. The method of claim 1, wherein the portion of the sticker is applied to a region of the object susceptible to tampering.
3. The method of claim 1, wherein the sticker comprises a first portion and a second portion, and applying at least a portion of the sticker on the object comprises:
separating the first portion of the sticker from the second portion of the sticker, and applying the first portion of the sticker on the object.

before applying the first portion of the sticker on the object, extracting initial orientation information from the sticker, the initial orientation information indicating relative spatial orientations of the respective elements of the first and second portions of the sticker; and generating an initial unique code based on the initial orientation information, the initial unique code associated with the sticker.

after applying the first portion of the sticker on the object, extracting second orientation information from the second portion of the sticker, the second orientation information indicating relative spatial orientations of the respective elements of the second portion of the sticker; and generating a second unique code based on the second orientation information, the second unique code associated with the second portion of the sticker and to application of the first portion of the sticker on the object.

6. The method of claim 1, wherein the distribution of elements resides on a surface of the substrate, and applying at least a portion of the sticker on the object comprises applying at least a portion of the substrate on the object.

7. The method of claim 1, wherein the distribution of elements resides in the adhesive, and applying at least a portion of the sticker on the object comprises applying at least a portion of the adhesive on the object.
8. The method of claim 7, wherein the substrate is a liner, and the method comprises removing the liner from the adhesive after applying at least a portion of the adhesive on the object.
9. The method of claim 1, wherein the elements are crystalline particles.
10. The method of claim 9, wherein the crystalline particles are diamond particles.
